source: validation.md and producer-validation.md; private raw evidence retained separately

method.mediaPath: native TCP -> pure Go producer -> go2rtc fragmented MP4
method.soak: three concurrent streams, nominal 120 seconds each; FFmpeg decode afterward
method.resourceSamples: two ps observations during capture; not mean, peak, or statistically comparable CPU
method.firstByte: HTTP request start to first response body byte, including keyframe wait
method.frameAge: separate three-second producer probes: local receipt time minus recorder frame timestamp
cautions: Separate runs from the HTTP and SDK measurements; do not infer a controlled performance ranking.
Frame age is not glass-to-glass latency and depends on camera/recorder clock synchronization.
Default I/P exact-duration lookahead adds one frame; fixed-GOP B-picture mode buffers a complete GOP and waits for closure.
Two minutes does not establish long-term endurance or maximum session capacity.

frameAge.reason: recorder timestamps ahead of local clock

reconnect.fault: bounded outage of test-owned native TCP relay only

talkdown.input: 300 ms all-zero mono PCM16 at 8000 Hz

acousticVerification.scope: device internal-microphone signal detection only; no human listening, room coverage or intelligibility assessment

contractScope.incomingAudio: not implemented; current ihub Exacq HTTP core exposes no listen method
contractScope.ptz: not implemented; current ihub Exacq HTTP core exposes no PTZ method
contractScope.singleForwardedPort: native TCP for control/media/events; not unique relative to HTTP Web Service
contractScope.nativeBenefit: removes vendor SDK binary, Exacq Web Service and event-callback dependency
contractScope.groups: actual parent/nested/audio-only recorder fixture passed compiled pure-Go VMS; exact cleanup verified
contractScope.motion: owner-scoped create/idempotence/delete with fresh readback; positive camera-generated VMD test alarm history
contractScope.backendSelection: explicit wire or SDK; no automatic fallback
contractScope.dotNet: Requires separately owned routing/URL host changes; 104 focused tests passed including actual compiled wire transport in ClearScript. Older unsupported hosts fail before dialing.
contractScope.bPictures: Explicit fixed-count progressive single-VCL closed-GOP subset; actual SDK input and generated recorder source correlated.
contractScope.audioOutput: Native chirp detected by device internal microphone with reversed-signal control and exact settings restoration; no room coverage or intelligibility claim.

bPictures.mode: explicit reorder=gop&gop=N; known fixed encoder count required
bPictures.input: generated 160x90 H.264 and HEVC, 45-picture cycle, 15-picture closed GOPs

timestampModel.pts: recovered presentation timestamp multiset assigned by POC
timestampModel.dts: synthesized monotonic decode deadlines no later than PTS

guards.fixedCountSource: independently known encoder configuration; never inferred from received data
guards.syntax: progressive single-VCL closed IDR; H.264 POC type0; qualified HEVC
guards.required: stable repeated parameters, dense unique POC, unique timestamps, next-IDR closure
unsupported: multiple VCL slices per access unit

boundaries.playbackEnd: complete final GOP; exclusive actual_end reported; sealing IDR not emitted
boundaries.snapshot: closure dependencies do not widen three-second presentation selection window

bPictures.validationLimit: Controlled generated recorder input; not arbitrary camera/encoder B-picture compatibility.

authentication.mechanism1: three actual SDK differential transcripts; no real recorder mechanism1 negotiation

authenticationQualification: SPAKE2+ actual isolated recorder26.1.7.3 negotiation/control plus bad-password rejection/recovery; original P224 unchanged

events.transport: recorder-originated HTTP webhook configured over native TCP
events.delivery: best-effort; failed recorder HTTP deliveries may be lost
